result.summary: The food delivery home screen is largely well laid out. The main visible defect is a typo in the search placeholder ('Restarants'). Other elements such as partially visible carousel items and the bottom card cut-off are expected scrolling behavior.

issues.description: Search field placeholder text contains a spelling error: 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' instead of 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.
